text: Explore how combining OpenCClip and all MiniLM L12v2 can build a powerful photo recommendation system.
By merging OpenCClip's image embeddings with all MiniLM L12v2's text embeddings,
learn how to improve photo recommendations through late fusion.
This method uses a tunable weight to seamlessly integrate visual and contextual data,
offering a refined approach without a database.
A straightforward setup with Node.js and Python makes it easy to implement.
Dive into the full article for detailed instructions on setting up this innovative system.
